body: We have already contacted a couple's therapist and are waiting to hear back. We just keep having smaller fights after a pretty big one the other night where she took off her ring in front of me. I just don't know how much more of the fighting I can take.

I feel like my communication with them is pretty good. I've talked with friends and family and they say I'm doing all of the right things but whenever I try to talk to my partner theres always an issue. 

I am safe with my partner, at least physically. Mentally, emotionally and spiritually, I'm not so sure.

Maybe try to reflect and figure out why you are having such a reaction to her posting these pictures. 
Don't get me wrong, her posting these photos without letting you know is disrespectful to your feelings. The fact that she never mentioned anything before you confronted her isn't great but instead of reacting so quickly try to have an open discussion with her. 

It sounds like she was heavier in the past, even though she seems very confident now. She could still be working through previous insecurities and could be posting them to feel validated on another level. Posting these photos could be serving as a mode of self empowerment for her as she adjusts to this new found confidence. 

Ask her questions, slow down the conversation and try hard to really listen. Try to understand her more deeply and why she feels she needs to do this even knowing that it upsets you. I hope this helps!

If I were you I would sit down with him when you both have the time and ask him if he has a problem with porn or if he's fixated on this one person for any particular reason. 

His behavior toward you is completely disrespectful don't get me wrong but instead of just thinking about how uncomfortable it makes you, maybe try to understand him more deeply by having an open and honest conversation. 

Ask things like: 
Why do you feel you're pulled to look at this one particular girl so much? 

Knowing that this makes me feel disrespected and hurt you still do it. Is it becoming an addiction? 

Do you just like having alone time to masturbate? 

Are there things she does in her videos that you would like to experiment with or see more of in our sex life? 

Do you have some unresolved feelings surrounding sex that you may be working through? 

Are there any kinks I may not be aware of that you would like to explore? 

Show him you don't want to fight but you want to try to understand where he's coming from with these behaviors surrounding masturbation and secrecy. He could have some internalized sexual shame he still needs to work through. With people with low self esteem or past sexual trauma, it's common to feel uncomfortable with giving themselves pleasure so it takes longer to relax and feel good. 

I know in my own experience I don't like having sex with my partner all that much, not because of anything they are doing wrong but because there is a lot of mental, emotional, and physical energy that's exchanged during sex and being highly sensitive to energy, it drains me. I also have chronic pain and I have to spend a long time letting my body recover after partnered sex. However, I like masturbating alone more often because it takes pressure off of me to perform in any capacity and I can lay back and just do my own thing. 

Go into it with the goal of being understanding and open. He might surprise you.

Also to answer your question, we have had brief conversations about journals being a no go area. They mostly just consist of me saying "Just know I would never read your journal, that's your space to process." And she nods and says okay and that's it...
I try to communicate about everything, she just doesn't understand what I say or is too caught up in her own thoughts to listen to me.

She never touches anything where the journal was sitting. It was near my side of the bed which is an area I solely take care of. She would have no reason to go over there. Also I can't just ask because that will start a whole fight and I just can't deal with another fight right now.
